fields.summary_ko.0: Meta Platforms (META) IPO'd on Nasdaq under ticker FB in 2012, changing its name to META in 2021 as it shifted focus to metaverse investment
fields.summary_ko.1: Meta is the world's largest social media platform used by over 2 billion daily and 3 billion monthly active users, generating tens of billions of dollars in annual revenue from advertising sales
fields.summary_ko.2: 2026 Q3 net income reached $9.86B, representing approximately 264% year-over-year growth, with 773 ETFs including VTI holding approximately 368 million shares
